title: Tax Invoice
key_sentences: This invoice covers the tenant survey analysis delivered under the agreement signed on 4 August 2026.
All amounts are shown in pounds sterling.
Please pay by bank transfer within 30 days and quote the invoice number as your reference.
Our bank details are printed on the remittance advice sent with this invoice.
Late payments may incur interest at 8% above the Bank of England base rate under the Late Payment of Commercial Debts Act.
The data cleaning line reflects twelve hours, two more than estimated, as agreed by email on 17 September.

notes: Commercial invoice, one page, built as a fixed page with letterhead and footer in the body. The letterhead (company name, address, VAT line) and the footer line are furniture, not headings. "Bill to" and "Invoice details" are two side-by-side boxes read box by box, left box first; the right box holds a borderless key/value table. The line-item table has subtotal, VAT and total rows whose label spans the first three columns, so the label is repeated in those three cells.
